what: When the section touches the top of the screen it stays pinned for 2200px (900 + 1300). During the first 900px the items (logos) in the center vertical column shift up one slot (118px) per 92px of scroll, shrinking by 1 − distance × .22 (minimum .5) and fading by 1 − distance × .42 the farther they are from the center, and only the center one gets is-active. As the section enters, items rise from one slot below with a .03 delay each and settle (cubic ease-out), and during the last 1300px the whole column slides up 60vh and disappears. The enter and exit values follow at .12 and .07 per frame

options.step: Scroll to advance one item (px), default 92
options.exit: Pinned range before it exits (px), default 1300 — 0 means it just transitions with no exit
options.[data-fx-part=row]: (if present) whole row that rises away together when exiting
options.fx:speed: While Fixed { velocity, slide, exit } brings it up — for tying side decorations (swaying lines, etc.) to scroll strength

from.where: index.html .mf (logo row section) — original manifesto.js: h 92, q 900, H 1300, w 118 (phone ×1.4), G .22, k .42, X .07, enter .12, R min(.3, s×.03), E .6, exit z .35 · 60vh
